parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no universal-exposure measure (no facility, custody, document or border rule), no documented violence against visitors, and no organised targeting — the worst documented feature is tier 3/5: a conservative, church-influenced society with thin, rarely-invoked recourse. Against that, current state threat-framing is real: the 2024 cabinet decision and November 2024 advocacy-ban drafting direct official suspicion at LGBTQIA+ visibility, raising the severity of outing even though the dossier locates that policy in resident organising, not visitors. Marriage exclusion and the near-absence of anti-discrimination law add little traveller-facing weight; prosecutorial guidance treating SOGI hostility as aggravating is a genuine but unproven positive. No documented service refusals, border friction or custody rules keep this above the 0.55 anchors; the active official hostility and unworking protections hold it below 0.65.
